reviews_verbatim.author: Lisa Solis
reviews_verbatim.text: The service was wonderful. Our dog was a little anxious at first, but our groomer was great with her. She loves to swim and had a lot of matting. The young man was amazing with her. The groomer did what I asked, cutting her nails, shaving her down, but only trimming her tail. She was so excited when she came back in. Thank you!

reviews_verbatim.author: Lori Laubscher
reviews_verbatim.text: I have a old pit mix. She can be temperamental. Her first grooming went with such ease. She seemed very comfortable with him. I will definitely use again....like tomorrow. Appointment already made.

reviews_verbatim.author: Sara Hagis
reviews_verbatim.text: They are exceptional and affordable. Great staff. Flexible with appointments. Amazing service.

reviews_verbatim.author: Marianne Fredericks
reviews_verbatim.text: Very happy with results. It was my first time using them and my sister & I were very happy & impressed. They made it very simple with making an appointment. Saul was awesome with our 4 dogs. He had quite the workout with our fur puppies.

reviews_verbatim.author: Evangeline
reviews_verbatim.text: Doggy's Dream did an amazing job with my Malinois Mix Poe, got all the shedd off his coat and brought him back to us with nails trimmed. We have used several groomers and have had trouble with them being able to trimm his nails, will definitely be using doggy's Dream again

owner_identified: Groomer named Saul mentioned by name in one review; another review mentions 'the young man' and 'him' without a name.
